resources.string: Limits decoded PCM only. A 2.0 connection can still carry AC3 5.1 through passthrough.
Keeps native passthrough first. Converts other multichannel audio to AC3 5.1 when PCM is limited to 2.0. Atmos height channels are lost.
AC3 transcoding unavailable: AC3 must be confirmed by the output and enabled in the codec list.
AC3 transcoding requires passthrough. Select Automatic or Prefer bitstream output and Automatic channel mix.
AC3 transcoding requires Automatic audio fallback.
Multichannel PCM preserves surround without re-encoding. AC3 transcoding is available with a 2.0 PCM connection.
AC3 transcoding is unavailable with the installed players.
